beginner.headline: Tomorrow (Fri Oct 9): conditional for beginner lessons, decided by water color. Wind drops to light SSE 5–7 mph with 40% scattered showers, but Thursday's Flash Flood Warning rain over all of Oʻahu means brown or turbid water at Waikīkī is likely into Friday, advisory posted or not. Evening forecast, so confidence is lower than a morning report; the morning on-site check decides.
beginner.recommendation: Hold Friday lessons as tentative, not confirmed. Go only if, on site, the water at Canoes and toward the Ala Wai / Kūhiō drains is visibly clear, there's no thunder, and the sets look manageable. If it runs, the 10:30 AM–1:00 PM window is preferred (rising tide after the 9:17 AM low, longest time since the rain, ahead of possible afternoon downpours). One student or a small group of strong adults first; multiple students or children only if the water is clearly clean and drift is low. Have a reschedule-to-Saturday plan ready: Saturday looks drier with light trades, though another long-period south pulse arrives.
